name: Ashfall Flats
blurb: A wasteland of volcanic powder and cracked obsidian where the wind carries the stench of old sulfur and nothing living moves.
art_prompt: grey ash dunes, black obsidian shards, rust-red volcanic stone, pale sky band above barren ground, scattered pumice, ash drifts catching weak light
shape: open ground under a wide sky, the surface itself the subject

name: Sunken Mangrove
blurb: A drowned forest of twisted roots and brackish water, where the air itself tastes of rot and things older than rot.
art_prompt: tangled grey-brown mangrove roots, brackish brown water, pale fungal blooms on bark, luminescent algae trails, saturated air thick with spores, vertical maze of trunks and prop-roots, no sky visible
shape: a dense field of vertical forms

name: The Furnace Galleries
blurb: A vast foundry abandoned mid-work: casting pits still radiating heat, iron framework spanning the darkness, bronze ingots stacked like tombs.
art_prompt: massive vaulted foundry interior, cast-iron support beams receding into shadow, cracked bronze vessels, rust-red oxide pooling on stone floor, dim amber light from cooling forge pits, copper-green patina on metal surfaces
shape: an interior receding away: a hall, nave, gallery or cavern with architecture to either side.

name: Bone Galleries
blurb: A vast ossuary laid bare by collapse—stacked crypts and funeral urns exposed to open sky, their ceramic vessels cracked and leaching ash.
art_prompt: weathered bone-white catacomb walls, shattered terracotta urns, grey ash drifts across pale stone floor, funeral wreaths turned black and brittle, wide pale sky above
shape: open ground under a wide sky, the surface itself the subject

name: Shattered Meridian
blurb: A forest of fractured crystal spires erupts from cracked earth, each one a shard of broken sky leaking impossible light; the air tastes of static and copper.
art_prompt: fractured crystal spires, jagged translucent shards, violet and white light bleeding between cracks, rust-red earth split and curled, amber veins running through broken glass, void-black fissures opening between columns, air shimmering with refracted impossible geometry
shape: a dense field of vertical forms

name: The Drowned Colosseum
blurb: A vast amphitheater flooded with luminous brine that reflects no light, where titanic ribs of some dead god breach the poisoned surface and the air tastes of copper and ending.
art_prompt: flooded amphitheater receding into murk, colossal pale ribcage emerging from bioluminescent green-grey water, rusted iron seating tiers half-submerged, salt-crusted stone columns, corpse-light reflecting off still toxic brine
shape: an interior receding away: a hall, nave, gallery or cavern with architecture to either side.
